objective: Bring a Shaman Voodoo Charm to Oben Rageclaw in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

description: The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.
You must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, <name>, bring one to me.
progress: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
completion: What an odd trinket this is... I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; this is a very powerful enchantment.
